  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Purchase Items from Online Shop" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Order" name="Split order activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SetPaymentMethod</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseReward_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SetPaymentMethod</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPaymentMethod_PaySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Pay or installment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPaymentMethod_PaySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaySplit_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaySplit_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaySplit_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_PayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaySplit_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Installment_PayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_PayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Installment_PayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PayMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Order" name="Join reward and payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseReward_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PayMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" name="Delivery required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Return_Split" name="Items returned for exchange?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_Split" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Order" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SetPaymentMethod" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Order" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseReward_Join" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPaymentMethod_PaySplit" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaySplit_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaySplit_Installment" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_PayMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_PayMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Order" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryMerge_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_ReturnSplit" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplit_End" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that must all be finished before a later activity can start, and it states no decision or order among them: Model the named activities as parallel branches opened by a parallel gateway, and join them with a parallel gateway before the later activity. Use an exclusive gateway only when the description states a choice between the activities.
rules.situation: the description states that two activities performed by the same actor happen simultaneously (for example with 'simultaneously' or 'at the same time'), states no order between them, and a later activity or decision follows both of them
